title: Retention, coherence and energy outflow of prepared torsional patterns on the radius-one curved mouth
scope: 0PN research. Radius 1, intake 0.25, held stationary axisymmetric geometry and passive archived order. Surface angular reduction in three brane dimensions plus depth w. No carrier work or advection. Times in model units, frequencies angular. Basic modal screen uses rho=chi and clamped waist only in preparation. No permanently bound state, physical downstream power, natural action or free fall determination.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import numpy as np
from numpy.polynomial import Legendre
from numpy.polynomial.legendre import leggauss


# For m=0 use X_phi = sqrt(1-x^2) P_l'(x), x=cos(theta).
# The radial component of curl on the sphere is
# -d[(1-x^2)P_l']/dx. No closed-form ratio is inserted in the quadrature.
x, weights = leggauss(20)
for l in range(1, 5):
    d = Legendre.basis(l).deriv()
    norm = weights @ ((1-x*x)*d(x)**2)
    radial_curl = 2*x*d(x) - (1-x*x)*d.deriv()(x)
    coeff = (weights @ radial_curl**2)/norm
    print(json.dumps({'degree': l, 'radial_curl_coefficient': coeff}))
    assert abs(coeff-l*(l+1)) < 2e-12

for p in sorted(Path('_scratch/s11c').glob('pattern_l*b*_01')):
    prep, release = map(json.loads, (p/'stdout').read_text().splitlines())
    path = p/'trace.npz'
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == release['trace_sha256']
    with np.load(path) as data:
        tr = data['trace']
        assert data['columns'].tolist() == ['time','feed_net','active_throat','weak_throat','receiver','cut_export','closure']
    independent_closure = np.max(abs(tr[:,1:6].sum(axis=1)-1))
    assert independent_closure < 1e-10
    for window, summary in release['windows'].items():
        lo,hi = (float(part) for part in window.split('-'))
        rows = tr[(tr[:,0]>=lo) & (tr[:,0]<hi)]
        np.testing.assert_allclose(rows[:,1:6].mean(axis=0), list(summary.values()),rtol=1e-13,atol=1e-15)
    early, late = [release['windows'][s] for s in ['4-8','44-48']]
    rates = {key: (late[key]-early[key])/40 for key in ['feed_net','cut_export','active_throat','weak_throat']}
    print(json.dumps({'job':p.name, 'independent_closure':independent_closure, 'initial_active':prep['initial_ordered'], 'window_secants':rates}))
